scheme_name: Spectacles Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Spectacles Scheme is an initiative launched by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board to provide financial assistance to workers in the unorganized sector who require spectacles for vision correction.

The scheme was officially launched on October 1, 2019.

The primary objective of the Spectacles Scheme is to ensure that workers in the unorganized sector have access to affordable eye care services.

The scheme aims to improve the quality of life for these workers by addressing vision-related issues that may hinder their productivity.

Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries can receive financial assistance of up to ₹1,000 for the purchase of spectacles.

This financial assistance is intended to cover the cost of basic spectacles and lenses.

The scheme specifically targets workers who are registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

To be eligible for this scheme, applicants must be at least 18 years of age.

There is no upper age limit specified for applicants.

The income criteria for eligibility is set at a maximum of ₹15,000 per month for the applicant's family.

Applicants must be residents of Haryana to qualify for the scheme.

The application process for the Spectacles Scheme involves several steps.

First, interested applicants must obtain the application form from the official website of the Haryana Labour Welfare Board or from designated offices.

The application form must be filled out completely with accurate personal and financial information.

Applicants are required to submit a copy of their identity proof.

Acceptable identity proofs include Aadhaar cards, voter ID cards, or any government-issued ID.

Additionally, applicants must provide proof of their income.

This can be in the form of a salary slip or an income certificate issued by a competent authority.

A recent passport-sized photograph is also required to be submitted with the application.

Once the application form and documents are ready, they must be submitted to the nearest Labour Welfare Board office.

The application can also be submitted online through the Haryana Labour Welfare Board's official website.

After submission, the application will be reviewed by the designated officials of the Labour Welfare Board.

The processing time for applications is typically around 30 days.

Once approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account.

Disbursement is usually done within 15 days of approval.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is responsible for implementing and monitoring the Spectacles Scheme.

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Haryana.

For any queries or assistance, beneficiaries can contact the Haryana Labour Welfare Board at their official helpline number.

The helpline number is 1800 180 2080.

The board also provides support through its official email address which is hlwb-hry@nic.in.

The Spectacles Scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Haryana government to enhance the welfare of workers in the unorganized sector.

The scheme recognizes the importance of vision correction in improving the productivity and quality of life of workers.

Since its launch, the scheme has benefited thousands of workers across Haryana.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board has reported that over 5,000 beneficiaries have availed of the financial assistance under this scheme in its first year.

The board continues to promote the scheme through various outreach programs.

These programs aim to raise awareness among workers about the importance of eye health.

Workers are encouraged to seek regular eye check-ups to prevent vision-related issues.

The Spectacles Scheme is aligned with the government's commitment to improving health and welfare services for all citizens.

The initiative reflects the government's understanding of the challenges faced by workers in the unorganized sector.

The scheme is also part of the larger framework of social security measures being implemented by the Haryana government.

The Haryana government has allocated a budget of ₹2 crore for the Spectacles Scheme for the financial year 2023-2024.

This allocation is aimed at expanding the reach of the scheme and increasing the number of beneficiaries.

The government plans to enhance the scheme by introducing additional benefits in the future.

These benefits may include free eye check-ups and partnerships with local optometrists.

The Spectacles Scheme is an important step towards ensuring that all workers have access to necessary health services.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board continues to monitor the implementation of the scheme closely.

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected regularly to improve the scheme's effectiveness.

The board is committed to making necessary adjustments based on this feedback.

The Spectacles Scheme is an example of how targeted welfare initiatives can make a significant difference in the lives of workers.

The scheme not only addresses immediate needs but also contributes to the overall well-being of the workforce.

As the scheme progresses, the Haryana government aims to expand its outreach and impact.

The Spectacles Scheme is a vital component of Haryana's efforts to promote health and welfare among its citizens.

It underscores the importance of vision care in enhancing productivity and quality of life.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board remains dedicated to ensuring that the benefits of the scheme reach those who need them the most.

By providing financial assistance for spectacles, the scheme helps to reduce the financial burden on low-income families.

The Spectacles Scheme is a testament to the Haryana government's commitment to social welfare and health care.

It serves as a model for similar initiatives in other states across India.

The scheme is expected to evolve over time to meet the changing needs of workers in the unorganized sector.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is actively seeking partnerships with NGOs and health organizations to enhance the scheme's effectiveness.

Through these collaborations, the board aims to provide comprehensive eye care services to workers.

The Spectacles Scheme is a significant step towards ensuring that all citizens have access to essential health services.

It reflects the government's dedication to improving the living standards of its workforce.

The scheme is a clear indication of the Haryana government's proactive approach to welfare and health care.
